name: LGD Verified
description: English As agent skills become a first-class distribution unit in AI-native ecosystems, evaluation frameworks for them remain fragmented: existing tools check metadata, licenses, or safety lists in isolation, without a coherent, machine-checkable, lifecycle-wide criterion. We present LGD Verified, a four-angle, evidence-gated scoring framework for AI skills - Registered (identity and provenance), Trustworthy (verifiability and reproducibility), Safe (guardrails and fail-closed posture), and Machine-readable (metadata and hygiene) - organized as a 24-dimension matrix with risk-weighted aggregation and a fail-closed pass threshold. Every dimension maps to existing public anchors (OpenSSF Scorecard-style checks, NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM/Agentic Top 10, SpecWeave, ai-skill-audit), making scores auditable, citable, and extensible. We ship a zero-dependency reference implementation and report dogfooding results: our 8-skill release suite passes 100/100 on quality gates, 34 community repositories were baseline-scored, and two widely-adopted official skill collections scored below the PASS threshold. The framework is not a certification, endorsement, or regulatory approval, and scores are self-reported/static unless independently verified.
